policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="estimatedPromptTokens" value='@{
            var body = context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true);
            var messages = body?["messages"] as JArray;
            if (messages == null)
            {
                return 0;
            }
            var text = "";
            foreach (var m in messages)
            {
                text += (string)m["content"] + " ";
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
            {
                return 0;
            }
            return (int)Math.Ceiling(text.Length / 4.0);
        }' />
        <emit-metric name="prompt-tokens-estimated"
            value='@((double)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("estimatedPromptTokens", 0))'
            namespace="llm-fallback">
